_comment: Hvigor parity allowlist — section 3.9 CI gate requirement.

entry.id: unique identifier for this allowlist entry
entry.fixture: fixture name (matches hvigor_parity.rs test name prefix)
entry.field_path: JSON-pointer or file path to the differing field/file
entry.reason: why this difference is expected and acceptable
entry.owner: GitHub username of the person who added this entry
entry.expires: ISO-8601 date after which this entry must be resolved or renewed

_instructions: Each entry allows a known parity difference to pass in strict mode.
Entries MUST have an `expires` date. Expired entries cause CI failure.
When a gap is fixed, delete the entry — do not just extend the expiry.
The CI job reads this file via ARKDOWN_PARITY_ALLOWLIST env var.
Cannot declare full parity (Phase 7 in gap analysis) while this list is non-empty.
